description: Source code for message formatting and handling in a command-line interface, including rendering tables, extracting message IDs, and formatting output for various message-related actions.

methods.name: resolveChannelLabel
methods.description: Resolves a channel label using plugin metadata or returns the channel ID.

methods.name: extractMessageId
methods.description: Extracts a message ID from a payload object, checking nested structures.

methods.name: buildMessageCliJson
methods.description: Builds a JSON envelope object for message CLI output from a message action result.

methods.name: renderObjectSummary
methods.description: Renders a summary table of an object's key-value pairs.

methods.name: renderMessageList
methods.description: Renders a list of messages in a table format.

methods.name: renderMessagesFromPayload
methods.description: Extracts and renders messages from a payload object.

methods.name: renderPinsFromPayload
methods.description: Extracts and renders pinned messages from a payload object.

methods.name: extractDiscordSearchResultsMessages
methods.description: Flattens Discord search results messages array.

methods.name: renderReactions

methods.name: formatMessageCliText
